020import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.QuickShopAPI;
021import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
022import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
023import org.bukkit.event.entity.EntityDamageByEntityEvent;
024import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerInteractEntityEvent;
025import org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerInteractEvent;
026import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
027import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
028
029/**
030 * InteractionBehavior
031 *
032 * @author creatorfromhell
033 * @since 6.2.0.11
034 */
035public interface InteractionBehavior {
036
037  /**
038   * Retrieves the identifier associated with this InteractionBehavior.
039   *
040   * @return the identifier as a String.
041   */
042  String identifier();
043
044  /**
045   * Used to handle interactions that a player has with a shop.
046   *
047   * @param shop        The shop involved in the interaction, not null.
048   * @param player      The player involved in the interaction, not null.
049   * @param event       The PlayerInteractEvent that triggered the interaction, not null.
050   * @param clickType   The type of click that triggered the interaction, not null.
051   * @param interaction The type of interaction that occurred, can be null.
052   */
053  void handle(final @NotNull QuickShopAPI plugin,
054              final @Nullable Shop shop,
055              final @NotNull Player player,
056              final @NotNull PlayerInteractEvent event,
057              final @NotNull InteractionClick clickType,
058              final @Nullable InteractionType interaction);
059
060  /**
061   * Handles player interactions with entities in the context of a shop.
062   *
063   * @param plugin      The QuickShopAPI instance used for handling the interaction, not null.
064   * @param shop        The shop involved in the interaction, can be null.
065   * @param player      The player involved in the interaction, not null.
066   * @param event       The PlayerInteractEntityEvent that triggered the interaction, not null.
067   * @param clickType   The type of click that triggered the interaction, not null.
068   * @param interaction The type of interaction that occurred, can be null.
069   */
070  default void handle(final @NotNull QuickShopAPI plugin,
071                      final @Nullable Shop shop,
072                      final @NotNull Player player,
073                      final @NotNull PlayerInteractEntityEvent event,
074                      final @NotNull InteractionClick clickType,
075                      final @Nullable InteractionType interaction) {
076
077  }
078
079  /**
080   * Handles interactions where a player damages an entity in the context of a shop.
081   *
082   * @param plugin      The QuickShopAPI instance used for handling the interaction, not null.
083   * @param shop        The shop involved in the interaction, can be null.
084   * @param player      The player involved in the interaction, not null.
085   * @param event       The EntityDamageByEntityEvent that triggered the interaction, not null.
086   * @param clickType   The type of click that triggered the interaction, not null.
087   * @param interaction The type of interaction that occurred, can be null.
088   */
089  default void handle(final @NotNull QuickShopAPI plugin,
090                      final @Nullable Shop shop,
091                      final @NotNull Player player,
092                      final @NotNull EntityDamageByEntityEvent event,
093                      final @NotNull InteractionClick clickType,
094                      final @Nullable InteractionType interaction) {}
095}
